Hi Sara —

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To get a PO issued and set up for payments we need the following from Nimbus: 

- Completed tax form: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US entity). If you are VAT-registered, a VAT registration certificate would also be helpful.
- Bank details (voided check or bank letter) for ACH/Wire.
- Completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (we've attached the template in the Drive link below).

Could you send the completed W-8BEN-E and bank details by end of day Tuesday so Aditya can start validation? Once finance confirms, we'll issue the PO and confirm payment terms (Net 30 by default). Rishi and I are cc'd for any legal/tax flags.

Drive folder for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cNimbusOnboarding
HubSpot: DEAL-7890

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations Lead

Monica —

I pulled the W-8BEN-E Sara sent. Quick notes from finance review: 

- W-8BEN-E appears filled and signed. We need to confirm the entity classification box (they selected "Corporation"). Please confirm if Nimbus is the beneficial owner on page 2 — if not, we need a declaration from an authorized signatory.
- Bank details look consistent. We'll run micro-deposit verification for ACH next week unless Nimbus prefers wire.
- VAT: the W-8 doesn't speak to VAT; if Nimbus is VAT-registered in the UK/EU, please upload a VAT registration certificate to the Drive folder. Without VAT docs, tax team flags reduced.

Action items: 
- Monica: confirm beneficial owner field with Sara (one-line reply will do).
- Rishi: please flag any legal concerns on the entity classification.
- Tessa: once finance confirms, can you create the PO in Coupa (or mark me and I'll create it)? We prefer PO before first invoice to avoid delays.

I'll hold PO creation until micro-deposit completes or wire instructions are confirmed.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, Finance Operations
